emergency.notice: 🔴 URGENT EMERGENCY NOTICE: GBS can cause respiratory muscle paralysis within hours. Seek immediate ICU emergency hospital care!
emergency.action: Seek immediate emergency hospital evaluation or call 112.

knownRisks: Individual herb sensitivities or gastrointestinal discomfort
Delayed medical diagnosis if severe symptoms are left unassessed
contraindications: Do not substitute herbal remedies for emergency hospital care in severe or acute illness
Consult physician during pregnancy, lactation, or underlying organ failure
interactions: Potential metabolic herb-drug interactions with prescription pharmaceuticals
safety.notes: Immunotherapy (IVIG/Plasmapheresis) in ICU is the standard life-saving treatment.
